facts.text: Jabiim appears as an optional text-based mission in the 2026 tactics game Star Wars Zero Company.

evidence.section: Behind the scenes > ''Star Wars Zero Company''
evidence.quote: Jabiim appears as an optional text-based mission in the 2026 tactics game Star Wars Zero Company.

facts.text: As the mission is optional, this article does not assume whether or not the covert operations group Zero Company undertook the mission.

evidence.section: Behind the scenes > ''Star Wars Zero Company''
evidence.quote: As the mission is optional, this article does not assume whether or not the covert operations group Zero Company undertook the mission.

facts.text: The mission entails Zero Company being approached by Republic Intelligence officer Bennic Halloren to rescue the three captured Republic Intelligence operatives in the Jabiim prison camp.

evidence.section: Behind the scenes > ''Star Wars Zero Company''
evidence.quote: The mission entails Zero Company being approached by Republic Intelligence officer Bennic Halloren to rescue the three captured Republic Intelligence operatives in the Jabiim prison camp.

facts.text: Should the player chose to take on the contract, Zero Company's operatives land on Jabiim and quickly manage to identify the three operatives they have been hired to rescue, but the team is also approached by prisoners willing to pay for freedom and those who simply beg for release.

evidence.section: Behind the scenes > ''Star Wars Zero Company''
evidence.quote: Should the player chose to take on the contract, Zero Company's operatives land on Jabiim and quickly manage to identify the three operatives they have been hired to rescue, but the team is also approached by prisoners willing to pay for freedom and those who simply beg for release.

facts.text: As such, the player is then asked whether they choose to rescue only the three Republic Intelligence officers, the officers and the several prisoners who are able to pay for rescue, or all the prisoners.

evidence.section: Behind the scenes > ''Star Wars Zero Company''
evidence.quote: As such, the player is then asked whether they choose to rescue only the three Republic Intelligence officers, the officers and the several prisoners who are able to pay for rescue, or all the prisoners.

facts.text: If the player chooses to free only the officers, Zero Company rationalizes that anything else is too dangerous and successfully extracts the officers, who, in turn, reward Zero Company with useful intelligence.

evidence.section: Behind the scenes > ''Star Wars Zero Company''
evidence.quote: If the player chooses to free only the officers, Zero Company rationalizes that anything else is too dangerous and successfully extracts the officers, who, in turn, reward Zero Company with useful intelligence.

facts.text: If the player chooses to save just the officers and paying customers, there is a chance they all will be extracted, in which case Zero Company is rewarded with both intelligence and credits.

evidence.section: Behind the scenes > ''Star Wars Zero Company''
evidence.quote: If the player chooses to save just the officers and paying customers, there is a chance they all will be extracted, in which case Zero Company is rewarded with both intelligence and credits.

facts.text: However, there is also a chance that the guards will be alerted to the situation, possibly due to an angered prisoner who was unable to pay and wants revenge on Zero Company for rejecting their pleas.

evidence.section: Behind the scenes > ''Star Wars Zero Company''
evidence.quote: However, there is also a chance that the guards will be alerted to the situation, possibly due to an angered prisoner who was unable to pay and wants revenge on Zero Company for rejecting their pleas.

facts.text: Zero Company is still able to rescue the three intelligence officers and several others, but many other prisoners were recaptured.

evidence.section: Behind the scenes > ''Star Wars Zero Company''
evidence.quote: Zero Company is still able to rescue the three intelligence officers and several others, but many other prisoners were recaptured.

facts.text: Finally, if the player decides to save all the prisoners, Zero Company's operators decide that no one deserves to "rot" in the Confederate prison.

evidence.section: Behind the scenes > ''Star Wars Zero Company''
evidence.quote: Finally, if the player decides to save all the prisoners, Zero Company's operators decide that no one deserves to "rot" in the Confederate prison.

facts.text: In one outcome, Zero Company is again besieged as the guards are alerted to the situation, resulting in many prisoners being recaptured, although Zero Company does manage to extract the intelligence officers and several other prisoners.

evidence.section: Behind the scenes > ''Star Wars Zero Company''
evidence.quote: In one outcome, Zero Company is again besieged as the guards are alerted to the situation, resulting in many prisoners being recaptured, although Zero Company does manage to extract the intelligence officers and several other prisoners.

facts.text: Alternatively, Zero Company might be able to liberate the entire prison camp in "a heist for the ages," after which Zero Company is handsomely rewarded.

evidence.section: Behind the scenes > ''Star Wars Zero Company''
evidence.quote: Alternatively, Zero Company might be able to liberate the entire prison camp in "a heist for the ages," after which Zero Company is handsomely rewarded.

facts.text: After completing the mission, there is also a chance the player will be invited to a high-stakes sabacc game by one of the liberated prisoners, who is still grateful for the rescue and offers Zero Company her seat at the tournament.

evidence.section: Behind the scenes > ''Star Wars Zero Company''
evidence.quote: After completing the mission, there is also a chance the player will be invited to a high-stakes sabacc game by one of the liberated prisoners, who is still grateful for the rescue and offers Zero Company her seat at the tournament.
